justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinter.java. PaddedNumberField is a small, cohesive nested helper with only 2 fields (field, size) and 3 methods (constructor, appendTo(Appendable, Calendar), appendTo(Appendable, int), estimateLength) at lines 260-304. Its only responsibility is padded numeric formatting, and selectNumberRule() at lines 1549-1556 uses it only for padding > 2; adjacent helpers like TwoDigitNumberField and UnpaddedNumberField show this file deliberately splits formatting concerns into separate focused rules rather than leaving this class under-modularized.
